acquisition: pages saved by Ryan, 2026-09-08, and read from ~/Dropbox/Football Archive/docs/hunting/
rights: CITED AS A SOURCE, not republished. Every claim names the page it came from. PFR is a compilation; what is taken is the fact it states, with PFR named as the one stating it.

_what_is_read.player pages: the meta block: full name, position, height, weight, birth and death date and place, college, high school.
_what_is_read.club-season pages: the per-player statistical tables -- age, position, games played, games started. THE ROSTER TABLE IS NOT IN THE SAVED PAGES; what is read is every man who appears in the passing, rushing-and-receiving or scoring table.

_corroboration_not_a_new_kind: PFR's 1934 Cincinnati Reds page is PFR's own compilation FROM THE SAME BOX SCORES the archive already read. It corroborates what the archive holds; it is not an independent roster. Every claim from that page carries `_same_evidence_as` saying so, because a reader counting sources would otherwise count this twice.
